item.title: AI Code's Bad Patterns Self-Replicate: 3 Instances Become 30, Silently
item.description: AI code decay isn't about 'low quality' — it's a structurally different kind of technical debt. Models treat your codebase as a style guide and faithfully replicate whatever patterns they find, including the wrong ones. A human team catches a bad pattern at 3 instances; AI silently propagates it to 30.

item.title: After AI Codes 10x Faster Than You, the Only Skill That Holds Value Is 'Understanding'
item.description: When AI can rewrite a JavaScript runtime in days, 'being able to write code' is no longer a moat. Geoffrey Litt proposes 'understand to participate,' pointing directly at the core paradox of AI programming: the faster the code is written, the shallower the understanding, and the heavier the cognitive debt.

item.title: Codex Mobile with Third-Party API: Exploiting the Auth/Model Layer Decoupling
item.description: Got Codex Mobile working with a third-party API relay. The key insight: Auth and Model layers are fully decoupled — ChatGPT handles identity, coding.rexai.top handles inference. Full configuration guide included.

item.title: The Claude Code Leak: How an Accident Sparked a Rust Rewrite Wave
item.description: In March 2026, Claude Code's 500k+ lines of TypeScript source code were accidentally leaked. Instead of panic, the developer community responded by rewriting the entire project in Rust. How did this mess turn into Rust's best advertisement for AI infrastructure?

item.title: Claude Code Channels: Give Your AI Coding Assistant a Phone Number
item.description: A hands-on look at Claude Code Channels, letting you control your AI coding assistant through Telegram, Discord, and more — no matter where you are.

item.title: You Use AI for Coding, But Have You Ever Used One That Holds Grudges?
item.description: When AI programming tools become goldfish - discussing the context loss pain point and how to make AI remember what you're working on

item.title: The Redis Author Had AI Write an Emulator, 30 Minutes to Run Through All Z80 Instructions
item.description: Redis founder antirez used Claude Code to implement a complete Z80 emulator in 30 minutes, passing the ZEXALL full instruction test. He designed a strict clean-room experiment: first had AI organize documentation, then cut off the network and implemented from scratch. Result: 1200 lines of code, zero bugs, and顺便 also built ZX Spectrum and CP/M environments.

item.title: Claude Code Re-Explores Your Codebase Every Session? CodeGraph Cuts That Cost by 30%
item.description: Claude Code burns through massive tokens re-exploring your codebase every new session. CodeGraph pre-builds a code knowledge graph that cuts exploration overhead by 30%. Stop paying the 'navigation tax' on repeat.

item.title: Tool Use: Teach AI to Make Phone Calls and Get Help When It's Stuck
item.description: Claude can't do math or query databases on its own. But you can teach it to 'make phone calls' — give it the numbers for calculators, databases, and other tools, and let it dial when needed.

item.title: Prompt Chaining: Make AI Check Its Own Work and Double Accuracy
item.description: Writing requires revision, and so do AI responses. Learn how to use prompt chaining to make Claude self-review and improve, dramatically boosting response accuracy. Like having AI write a draft, check it, polish it, and hand you a perfect final answer.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.86.0 Update: Skill Config, Web Search, Sandbox Elevation & More
item.description: OpenAI Codex CLI, this terminal tool, received major version updates from 0.80.0 to 0.86.0, including SKILL.toml skill config, web search control, sandbox elevation, and headless login. Let's see how to make the most of AI programming.

item.title: I Spent $400 on Claude Code, Then Switched to Codex
item.description: After a month and $400, I went from being a Claude Code fanatic to a Codex user. This is a real user experience report.

item.title: Claude Code: The AI Programming Assistant That's Like Having a 24/7 Personal Butler for Your Code
item.description: Deep dive into Claude Code AI programming assistant - from local execution to natural language interaction, see how this Claude 4-based tool transforms developers' daily workflow

item.title: Deep Dive into Claude Code Subagents: Building Your AI Team Like LEGO Blocks
item.description: Master Claude Code CLI's subagent mechanism and learn how to manage your AI assistants like building a team, with each agent specializing in their own domain to boost development efficiency.
